subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should unconfigured embedded connection and transport-timeout retries intentionally move from provider SDK request retries to one outer primary-to-fallback cycle retry?
rationale: Both approaches can prevent retries inside the released prompt-lock window, but they differ in model order, latency, diagnostics, lock reacquisition, and compatibility for existing users; repository history does not establish that product contract.

options.title: Approve outer retry ownership
options.body: Keep the current design after exact-head proof demonstrates the intended bounded behavior for single-model and multi-model configurations.

options.title: Narrow to session fencing
options.body: Preserve provider SDK retry semantics and land only owned transcript writes plus safe takeover reporting.

options.title: Split retry policy
options.body: Land the session-state repair separately and review retry ownership in a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Approve outer retry ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the current design after exact-head proof demonstrates the intended bounded behavior for single-model and multi-model configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent current-main ownership signal for the central reply and fallback decision surface points to this contributor.
